description: Array element assignment and read: arr[0] and arr[1] written separately, both read in one print, with A editing one element and B an independent variable. Clean and round-trips. Note the precision this does NOT have: Joern models arr[0] = 5 as an assignment whose target is an indexAccess, so element-level dependence is not distinguished - two writes to *different* elements of one array would be treated as writes to the same location. That costs precision (over-approximation, so still safe) and is invisible here because only one element is edited.
category: false textual conflict — semantics merges it (array elements)
